hazards.name: Ion Storm
hazards.effect: Sensors -50%, random system damage, shuttles grounded.
hazards.counter: Wait it out; regenerative shields reduce damage.

hazards.name: Plasma Storm (Badlands)
hazards.effect: Heavy damage over time; ideal raider hideout.
hazards.counter: Navigational deflector upgrades; local guides (Maquis contacts).

hazards.name: Mutara-type Nebula
hazards.effect: Shields and sensors offline inside; visual-range combat only.
hazards.counter: Tactical choice: lure enemies in (Wrath of Khan).

hazards.name: Metreon Gas Cloud
hazards.effect: Weapons fire ignites gas: area explosion.
hazards.counter: Hold fire; or bait enemies into it.

hazards.name: Subspace Rift
hazards.effect: Damages nearby ships; warp in system disabled; firing torpedoes into it can make it expand.

hazards.name: Graviton Ellipse
hazards.spawn: surfaces from subspace without warning, moves
hazards.effect: Pulls and crushes ships in its path.
hazards.counter: Early-warning sensors; get out of the way.

hazards.name: Temporal Anomaly
hazards.effect: Random: ship sent forward in time (vanishes N minutes), aged hull, or duplicated.

hazards.name: Quantum Rift
hazards.effect: Portal to alternate universe; may spawn Mirror Universe ships.
hazards.counter: Seal it with a tachyon pulse, or exploit it for research.

hazards.name: Tholian Web
hazards.effect: Traps ships in a contracting energy net.
hazards.counter: Destroy a weaver before it completes; interphase effects.

hazards.name: Cosmic String
hazards.counter: Avoid; study for big research payout.
